title: Soda Prices Stay Fizzed Up
story: Many kids thought soda prices would go down, but they stayed the same. This means they still have to save up to buy their favorite FIZZ.
storyBig: Expectations for a drop in soda prices were dashed as major suppliers kept prices steady. This development leaves consumers needing to make strategic decisions about their soda purchases.
think: Why do you think soda prices didn't drop?
bull: FIZZ might still be a popular choice, keeping sales strong.
bear: High prices might push kids to choose other drinks.

title: Toy Makers Seek New Ideas With Contests
story: Toy companies are holding fun contests to find the coolest new toy ideas. Kids pitch their ideas like a game show.
storyBig: Toy manufacturers are adopting innovative recruitment strategies by hosting competitions to gather fresh ideas. This approach allows them to discover creative talents in a unique and dynamic way.
think: What new toy idea would you pitch?
bull: This could lead to exciting new toy inventions!
bear: Some kids might feel nervous about participating.
